reason: It reads better than the usual LinkedIn agency pitch and the free list of 15 companies costs me nothing but a call, so I might take that. But paying for the pilot needs my partner to sign off, and one logistics case study with 45 meetings won't get that done this month.
objection: I get three or four of these pitches a week and they all promise meetings. I don't know you, I've seen one result from a logistics firm and none from a wholesaler like mine, and I'm afraid the 'qualified' meetings turn out to be tyre-kickers I spend my days arguing about inside a 48-hour window.
would_change_my_mind: The free list of 15 companies actually naming buyers I don't already know in the target country, plus a reference I can phone at a distributor my size who signed real orders from your meetings.
